remarks: Welcome to 73 Fawn Ridge Lane, a beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse in one of Norwalk's most sought-after condo communities in the desirable Cranbury section of town. Offering the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and lifestyle, this move-in ready, coveted courtyard unit features an open and inviting main level designed for both everyday living and entertaining, complete with a real fireplace and seamless flow between the living and dining spaces. Enjoy your morning coffee on its welcoming front porch overlooking the landscaped courtyard, soak up morning sun or unwind on the private rear deck for added outdoor privacy. Also on the main level, this unit features a versatile bonus room just off the kitchen-perfect for a home office, playroom, or cozy sitting area. Upstairs, both spacious bedrooms feature ample closet space and en-suite full bathrooms, creating an ideal setup for family, guests, or roommates. The partially finished basement adds valuable flexible space perfect for a gym, office, rec room, or additional living area, while still offering plenty of storage. Additional highlights include central air, a new water heater, garage with direct access to the kitchen, carport, grounds, swimming pool, and tennis/pickleball courts. All this in an unbeatable location just steps to shopping, restaurants, and everyday conveniences, with quick access to I-95, the Route 7 Connector, Merritt Parkway, and Metro-North. Schedule your private showing today!
